headerSubtitle: Authentic answers from Dr. Sheikh Falah Kurkully — grounded in Qur'an, Sunnah & the Salaf.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: To build a comprehensive, easy-to-navigate encyclopaedia of Islamic knowledge—rooted in the Qur'an, the Prophet's Sunnah, and the methodology of the righteous predecessors (Salaf).

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: Ask Sunnah is an educational & da'wah platform offering clear, academic answers supervised by Dr. Sheikh Falah Kurkully (PhD in Hadith Sciences).

aims.title: Aims
points: Spread the message of Islam and call people to its beauty.
Dispense authentic knowledge and dispel ignorance.
Answer contemporary needs with evidence from sacred texts.
Offer practical advice on daily issues through scholarly guidance.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.text: We adhere to the beliefs of Ahl as-Sunnah wa'l-Jamaa'ah and follow the scholars of the Salaf as-Saaliheen.
points: Is based on the Holy Qur'an and authentically-narrated Sunnah (Saheeh).
Reflects the views of the four Imams: Abu Haneefah, Maalik, ash-Shaafa'i, and Ahmad.
Is cross-checked with contemporary fiqh councils and leading Hadith research.
Avoids fruitless debates, focusing instead on beneficial, evidence-based guidance.

bio.title: About Dr. Sheikh Falah Kurkully
bio.text: Dr. Sheikh Falah Karkoli is a distinguished Islamic scholar who holds a PhD in Hadith Sciences. He studied under renowned scholars such as Sheikh Ibn Uthaymeen, Sheikh Saleh Al-Fawzan, Sheikh Abdul-Muhsin Al-Abbad, Sheikh Muqbil bin Hadi Al-Wadi'i, and Sheikh Abu Bakr Al-Jaza'iri. With decades of experience in teaching and Islamic outreach (da'wah), he provides answers on AskSunnah that are rooted in knowledge, precision, and scholarly integrity.

dua: O Allah, make us steadfast on the path of guidance, help us adhere to what pleases You, and accept our humble efforts, Ameen.
